apiV2OnSiteFcpSummaryTime.name: apiV2OnSiteFcpSummaryTime
apiV2OnSiteFcpSummaryTime.returns: time-on-site aggregates per week and per FCP/market (dwell totals and averages), one row per week × facility

apiV2OnSiteStatusBreakdownTime.name: apiV2OnSiteStatusBreakdownTime
apiV2OnSiteStatusBreakdownTime.returns: counts of on-site GPS validations by validation status (validated, failed, missing) per week

apiV2ArticleUpdate.name: apiV2ArticleUpdate
apiV2ArticleUpdate.returns: revision confirmation for a knowledge base article whose body was corrected, with the stored change reason and human-edit guard result

apiV2ZoneZipcode.name: apiV2ZoneZipcode
apiV2ZoneZipcode.returns: zipcode-to-delivery-zone assignments with mileage/distance per zipcode used for financial zone pricing, filterable and keyset-paged
